items.reason: A single main interrogative asks how Abimelech kills the leaders; “Shechem's” is a possessive modifier. There are no embedded clauses or unresolved pronouns.

The temporal clause “when handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched Paul were taken to the sick” contains the relative clause “that had touched Paul” inside a passive construction. This nested temporal/passive structure creates avoidable burden; no referent is unresolved.

“四个长大麻风的人说坐在这里也必死” supplies one reported statement before the main question “之后他们决定怎么做”. “长大麻风的” modifies “人”, and “他们” clearly refers to those four people. The main question asks about an action, not another viewpoint.
“王吩咐人捉拿谁” is a direct command construction with “谁” as the object of “捉拿”. The option “从犹大来的神人” has one ordinary noun modifier. “王” is uniquely identified in context; no referent remains unresolved.

The temporal setup “迦勒第一次说有人来时” embeds reported speech, while “西布说他看见的其实是什么” asks about another speaker's account of a perception. This requires nested viewpoint tracking. “他” also leaves its reference to 迦勒 rather than 西布 to contextual inference.

“他们请谁为他们求问这趟行程” is a compact request construction: “谁” is the requested intermediary, and “为他们” marks the beneficiaries. Both instances of “他们” refer to the requesting group in the dialogue; their individual identities are unnecessary.

The main question contains one reported-content clause: the spies said the objects “were in one of the houses”. “The spies” is clear in context, and “one of the houses” is an ordinary location phrase, with no unresolved referent.
“亚比筛击杀了谁” is a single subject–verb–object question without embedded clauses. The options are short noun phrases, and no pronoun or other referent requires resolution.

The main passive question “由谁统领” is simple, but its subject “这三十万七千五百训练有素的军队” unnaturally attaches a bare personnel count to “军队”, requiring mental repair. “训练有素的” is the deepest modifier; “这” clearly points to the army in the passage.
“这封信是谁写的” is a straightforward 是……的 construction asking for the writer, with no embedded clause. “这封信” uniquely refers to the supplied letter.
